title: 灯泡开关 Ⅱ
summary: n 个初始开启的灯泡，四种固定翻转操作恰好执行 presses 次，求可能得到的不同灯泡状态数量。
insight: 操作模式每两次抵消，且前六盏灯已决定后续周期状态；枚举四个按钮按下奇偶性并筛选总次数奇偶与上限。
pitfalls: 按钮可重复按，最终只看每个按钮次数奇偶
奇数按钮数不能超过 presses 且同奇偶
只需模拟 min(n,6) 盏灯

solutions.title: 枚举四按钮奇偶组合
solutions.idea: 16 种奇偶掩码筛选后模拟灯泡状态并去重。
steps: 枚举 mask 从 0 到 15，令 used=bitCount(mask)
模拟前 min(n,6) 盏灯受四按钮影响后的位状态，加入集合；返回集合大小

code.java: class Solution { public int flipLights(int n,int presses){Set<Integer> states=new HashSet<>();int lamps=Math.min(n,6);for(int mask=0;mask<16;mask++){int used=Integer.bitCount(mask);if(used>presses||((presses-used)&1)!=0)continue;int state=0;for(int index=1;index<=lamps;index++){boolean on=true;if((mask&1)!=0)on=!on;if((mask&2)!=0&&index%2==0)on=!on;if((mask&4)!=0&&index%2==1)on=!on;if((mask&8)!=0&&(index-1)%3==0)on=!on;if(on)state|=1<<(index-1);}states.add(state);}return states.size();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun flipLights(n:Int,presses:Int):Int{val states=hashSetOf<Int>();val lamps=minOf(n,6);for(mask in 0 until 16){val used=Integer.bitCount(mask);if(used>presses||(presses-used)%2!=0)continue;var state=0;for(index in 1..lamps){var on=true;if(mask and 1!=0)on=!on;if(mask and 2!=0&&index%2==0)on=!on;if(mask and 4!=0&&index%2==1)on=!on;if(mask and 8!=0&&(index-1)%3==0)on=!on;if(on)state=state or (1 shl index-1)};states.add(state)};return states.size} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int flipLights(int n,int presses){set<int> states;int lamps=min(n,6);for(int mask=0;mask<16;++mask){int used=__builtin_popcount(mask);if(used>presses||(presses-used)%2)continue;int state=0;for(int index=1;index<=lamps;++index){bool on=true;if(mask&1)on=!on;if((mask&2)&&index%2==0)on=!on;if((mask&4)&&index%2==1)on=!on;if((mask&8)&&(index-1)%3==0)on=!on;if(on)state|=1<<(index-1);}states.insert(state);}return states.size();} };
